title: Critical Mass Simulator – heat hydrogen into plasma, cage it with magnets, then collapse it into a black hole (free, WebGPU)
author: Existing_Bid9916

comments.author: Existing_Bid9916
comments.body: Dev here. 5 short guided levels, about 15–30 minutes total. Needs a WebGPU browser (Chrome/Edge 113+); Firefox/Safari may show "REACTOR OFFLINE". Would love to hear which level felt hardest.

replies.author: Existing_Bid9916
replies.body: Thanks for trying! 429 is [itch.io](http://itch.io) rate-limiting your connection – it usually clears in a minute or two. If you're on a VPN, turning it off for a moment helps. Sorry about that!
